Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a dialogue between the department of licensing, county auditors, and subagents regarding title and registration activities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a dialogue between the department oflicensing, county auditors, and subagents regarding title andregistration activities; and adding a new section to chapter 46.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The director or the director's designee and another director'sdesignee shall meet once a year with two county auditors nominated bythe Washington association of county officials and two representativesof subagents nominated by an association of vehicle subagents. Thismeeting must be held at the department's headquarters in Olympia and bea minimum of four hours, but a maximum of eight hours, in duration.The purpose of the meeting is to provide an opportunity for a dialogueto occur to express concerns and ideas. If all six attendees agree, asecond meeting may be held, but no more than two meetings may be heldin one year. The department must not incur any costs associated withthese meetings.
